reason: New seller with no reviews, and the tyres aren't included unless the listing says so. I'd have to buy tyres on top, so £240 isn't really the price. Viewing first and paying on collection helps, but it's still a gamble on an unknown seller.
objection: No reviews, so I don't know if this lot actually does a proper repair on kerbed wheels. And without good tyres on them it's an extra cost I was trying to avoid.
would_change_my_mind: A set with decent tyres included at a clear price, plus a few real reviews or photos of other customers' finished sets.
